description: the card returned a signed or encrypted Proof-of-Receipt (PoR) response that may be crackable offline (cryptographic checksum or encrypted response material collected for analysis, not cracked in-tool)
reference: ETSI TS 102 225 / TS 102 226 (Proof of Receipt, security mechanisms)
remediation: review the collected PoR material offline; ensure OTA security uses strong algorithms, fresh counters, and keys not susceptible to offline recovery
